seo_title: A Local's FAQ: Common Questions About Bakudan Ramen
h1: A Local's FAQ: The Most-Asked Questions About Bakudan Ramen
meta_description: Answers to the most common questions about Bakudan Ramen — locations, hours, ordering, happy hour, and menu options — all verified against current info.
audience: Anyone with a quick logistical question before visiting

faq.question: How many Bakudan Ramen locations are there?
faq.answer: Three, all in San Antonio: Bandera Road, Stone Oak, and La Cantera.

faq.question: What are Bakudan Ramen's hours?
faq.answer: Monday–Thursday 11:00 AM–8:30 PM, Friday–Saturday 11:00 AM–9:00 PM, and Sunday 11:00 AM–8:00 PM, the same at all three locations.

faq.question: Is the menu the same at every location?
faq.answer: The ramen, starters, and food menu are the same everywhere. What differs is the drink program: Stone Oak and La Cantera have a full cocktail and wine list, while Bandera has a dedicated saké bar instead.

faq.question: When is happy hour?
faq.answer: Daily from 3–6 PM at all three locations, though what's included varies — Stone Oak and La Cantera run cocktail-focused happy hour pricing, while Bandera's is saké-focused.

faq.question: How do I order online?
faq.answer: Through the order page, which routes you to your chosen location's ordering system on Toast for pickup or delivery. Delivery areas, fees, and estimated times are managed by Toast.

faq.question: Is there a vegetarian option?
faq.answer: Yes — the Vegetarian ramen bowl, built on an oat milk and garlic oil base with tofu, spinach, and cabbage, with no animal broth.

faq.question: Is there a kids' menu?
faq.answer: Yes — Kids Ramen is $8.50, a simplified chicken broth bowl with chicken chashu, corn, and thin noodles.

faq.question: Which location opened first?
faq.answer: La Cantera, in May 2019. Stone Oak followed in October 2022, and Bandera Road opened in February 2023.

body_html:
These are the questions that come up most often about visiting Bakudan Ramen — locations, hours, ordering, and the menu. Everything below is answered directly, without padding.

A Note on What's Not Covered Here

This FAQ sticks to what's verified and current: locations, hours, ordering, and menu basics. If you have a question about something more specific — gift cards, catering, or dietary restrictions beyond what's listed on the vegetarian and kids' menu items — the most reliable answer is to call your nearest location directly, since that's not something covered in general marketing content.
